 Early look at Halloween: Will your forecast be a trick or a treat? By Caitlin Kaiser • 14 hours ago Updated: October 22, 2026, 7:56 am EDT Published: October 21, 2026, 2:39 pm EDT Halloween is full of all things spooky and scary, but the weather shouldn’t be the thing sneaking up on you this year. The temperature outside along with whether it rains or not, can make or break your perfect costume. But this outlook can help you plan based on the weather trends region-by-region. Here’s an early look at your forecast.
